Generated Narrative: ConceptMap WHOHivToNgHivLocal

Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts to (not specified)


Group 1 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to HIV Follow Up Status CodeSystem

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.H.DE42 (Lost to follow-up)is equivalent tolost (Lost to follow-up)WHO and Nigeria concepts represent loss to follow-up in HIV treatment follow-up.
HIV.H.DE43 (Transferred out)is equivalent toto (Transferred out)Nigeria 'to' is the established local code for transferred out.
HIV.H.DE44 (Death (documented))maps loosely todeadWHO explicitly requires documented death; the Nigeria local concept is broader.
HIV.D.DE45 (Restarting ART)is equivalent torestart (Restart ART)Both represent restarting ART after an interruption.
HIV.D.DE40 (Stopped ART)is equivalent tostop (Stopped ART)Both represent ART having been stopped.
HIV.H.DE45 (Refused (stopped) treatment)maps loosely tostop (Stopped ART)WHO is narrower because it specifies confirmed refusal/stopping treatment.
HIV.H.DE47 (On ART)is equivalent toalive-on-artBoth indicate that the client is currently alive and receiving ART.

Group 2 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to HIV-ARV Adherence CodeSystem

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.D.DE40 (Stopped ART)maps loosely toStoppedThe Nigeria code is used in an adherence/status context while WHO states treatment status.

Group 3 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to HIV DSD - Reason For Category Change CodeSystem

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.H.DE42 (Lost to follow-up)is equivalent toLost
HIV.H.DE43 (Transferred out)is equivalent toTO (Transferred out)
HIV.H.DE44 (Death (documented))maps loosely toDeadWHO is narrower because it specifies documented death.

Group 4 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to HIV Positive Tracking

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.H.DE4 (Did not initiate ART)is equivalent toNot-Started (ART not started)
HIV.D.DE382 (ART initiated within 7 days of diagnosis)maps loosely toStarted-ARTNigeria is broader because it does not restrict ART initiation to seven days.
HIV.B.DE147 (Linked to enrolment in care and ART initiation)maps loosely toLinked-To-CareWHO includes enrolment linkage and ART initiation; the Nigeria concept represents linkage to care.
HIV.H.DE41 (HIV treatment outcome)maps loosely toFinal-OutcomeNigeria represents the final tracking outcome; WHO represents the treatment outcome used for retention/attrition.

Group 5 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to HIV - Final Outcome CodeSystem

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.H.DE42 (Lost to follow-up)is equivalent tolost-to-follow-up
HIV.H.DE44 (Death (documented))maps loosely todiedWHO explicitly requires documented death; the Nigeria outcome is broader.
HIV.H.DE45 (Refused (stopped) treatment)maps loosely todeclinedNigeria 'declined' is broader than WHO's confirmed refusal/stopping treatment.
HIV.D.DE382 (ART initiated within 7 days of diagnosis)maps loosely tostarted-artNigeria is broader because it does not specify the seven-day initiation window.
HIV.H.DE49 (Transfer confirmed)maps loosely toconfirmed-referralBoth describe confirmed onward movement, but WHO is specifically a confirmed transfer.

Group 6 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to HIV - Reason Not Started ART CodeSystem

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.D.DE371 (Patient self-reported as not ready/willing)maps loosely todeclinedNot ready/willing is narrower than the local declined category.
HIV.D.DE372 (Not completed education, support and preparation for ART)maps loosely toon-adherence-preparationBoth describe preparation/support before ART initiation, but the local category is broader.
HIV.H.DE47 (On ART)maps loosely toknown-positive-on-artLocal code is used as a reason not to newly initiate a person already known to be on ART.
HIV.D.DE377 (Patient diagnosed with cryptococcal meningitis)maps loosely toon-oi-managementCryptococcal meningitis is a specific opportunistic infection within the broader local OI-management category.
HIV.D.DE378 (Patient diagnosed with histoplasmosis)maps loosely toon-oi-managementHistoplasmosis is a specific opportunistic infection within the broader local OI-management category.
HIV.D.DE380 (Other)is equivalent tootherBoth are the residual other-reason category for delayed/non-initiation of ART.

Group 7 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to Target Population Category Codes

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.B.DE51 (Sex worker)maps loosely toFemale-Commercial-Sex-WorkersWHO includes sex workers generally; the Nigeria target category is female-specific.
HIV.B.DE52 (Men who have sex with men)is equivalent toMSM (Men who have sex with men)
HIV.B.DE53 (Trans and gender-diverse people)maps loosely toTG (Transgender)WHO explicitly includes gender-diverse people in addition to transgender people.
HIV.B.DE54 (People who inject drugs)is equivalent toPeople-Who-Inject-Drug (People who inject drugs)
HIV.B.DE58 (Orphan or vulnerable child)maps loosely toOVC-AIDS-Orphaned (OVC/AIDS orphaned)WHO is broader than the Nigeria category, which is specifically HIV/AIDS-oriented.

Group 8 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to TB TPT Prophylaxis Type Codes

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.D.DE250 (Provide isoniazid preventive therapy)maps loosely toinh (Isoniazid preventive therapy)WHO represents the service/action; Nigeria represents the local prophylaxis type.

Group 9 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to Enhanced Adherence Counselling

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.D.DE496 (Enhanced adherence counselling provided)maps loosely toeac (Enhanced adherence counselling)WHO represents provision of EAC; Nigeria represents the EAC concept itself.

Group 10 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to NG HIV Care and ART Codes

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.D.DE223 (Other reason for stopping ART)is equivalent toart-stop-reason-10 (Other reason for stopping ART)
HIV.D.DE425 (Other reason for regimen substitution)maps loosely toregimen-change-reason-10 (Other regimen change reason)Nigeria combines substitution/switch reasons; WHO is specifically substitution.
HIV.D.DE434 (Other)maps loosely toregimen-change-reason-10 (Other regimen change reason)WHO code is specifically other within regimen switch; Nigeria combines substitution/switch reasons.

Group 11 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to NG HIV Enhanced Adherence Counselling Form Codes

Source CodeRelationshipTarget Code
HIV.D.DE215 (Other reason for nonadherence)is equivalent tobarrier-other (Other adherence barrier)

Group 12 Mapping from http://smart.who.int/hiv/CodeSystem/HIVConcepts|1.0.0 to NG HIV Integrated Laboratory Form Codes

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
HIV.B.DE84 (Nucleic acid test for HIV)maps loosely totest-type-eid (Early infant diagnosis)WHO describes the virological test method; Nigeria uses an EID programme test-type category.
HIV.D.DE406 (HIV viral load test ordered)maps loosely totest-type-viral-load (Viral load)WHO represents the order action; Nigeria represents the requested test type.
HIV.D.DE364 (CD4 count)maps loosely toother-test-cd4-count (CD4 count)WHO represents the CD4 count data element; Nigeria code identifies the requested/recorded test type.
HIV.D.DE365 (CD4 cell percentage)maps loosely toother-test-cd4-percentage (CD4 percentage)WHO represents the CD4 percentage data element; Nigeria code identifies the requested/recorded test type.

name: WHOHivToNgHicLocal
title: WHO HIV to Nigeria HIV Local Concepts
description:
Directional ConceptMap from the WHO SMART Guidelines HIV Concepts CodeSystem
version 1.0.0 to Nigeria HIV local programme CodeSystems. Only mappings with
a defensible semantic relationship are included. `equivalent` is used where
the source and target meanings substantially correspond; `inexact` is used
where one concept is broader, narrower, contextual, or represents an action
rather than the local programme category. Unlisted WHO concepts are intentionally
left unmapped pending programme and terminology review.
purpose:
Supports country adaptation, terminology translation, interoperability, and
traceability between WHO SMART HIV DAK concepts and Nigeria HIV programme
terminology. This map is directional (WHO to Nigeria) and SHALL NOT be assumed
to provide lossless reverse translation. Clinical or reporting use of mappings
marked `inexact` requires review of the source context.
